content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Today I tried to run the [product_name] App on both an Android and an iPhone, and encountered some issues: First, on my Android device (OnePlus 2 with Android [version_no] and OxygenOS [version_no]), the installation went smooth, but when running the app, I received the message: "For security reasons, the app is not supported on jailbroken devices" and it closes immediately. However, this is not an iPhone, and since it's an Android that hasn't been rooted, this warning seems incorrect. Is there a way to modify app files to bypass this problem? Second, on iPhone, I couldn't even find the [product_name] App in the App Store, possibly due to geo-restrictions. Is there any workaround for this? Thank you in advance, [user_name]

Hi, I'm using Android [version_no] on a Samsung S6 and the app works for me without issues. Try visiting Google.com to install the app. There is a contact option for the developers, who may be able to assist you. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing problems with the [product_name] App on both Android and iOS devices. On Android, the app mistakenly identifies the device as jailbroken despite it not being rooted, preventing usage. On iOS, the app is unavailable due to regional restrictions, blocking installation. Some users report successful usage under similar Android conditions, indicating possible inconsistencies in device or OS checks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] App to install and operate smoothly on both Android and iOS devices, without incorrect jailbreak or root detection, and to be accessible in the App Store regardless of geographic location.
